scope_limits: Only the specified exact-real four-block, no-LN graph, one coefficient and fixed stationary positive fast-mixing order-two binary source are covered. No general architecture, minimax, learned-parameter or ordinary IEEE conclusion follows.

The score-relative coefficient eta_N=c/(N+2) and absolute scalar-weight change 4c/(N+2) differ. These are N-dependent perturbed models, not one fixed deployment. The previous fixed-q 3/16 limit has different quantifiers.

Critical c=2 uses the genuine moving-target correction: only the L1 difference tends to zero. Neither the moving terminal comparator nor terminal window is asserted to converge; no independent query is introduced.

Fixed-c open intervals require both endpoint companions and reviews for the combined positive-c statement. Varying c_N and c>3/2 remain outside that group, apart from the separately proved c=2 example.
The c=1/2 all-N claim compares final model outputs, not entire residual vectors or an exact common 1/2 output at N=2. The c=3/2 terminal data-index formula requires N>=3.
The asymptotic risk function has right-hand limit 5/32 at fixed c=1/2; finite-N softmax/ReLU outputs remain continuous in parameters. This is not a universal or finite-N sharp robustness threshold.

The original Q scalar -4 is exactly representable in common binary floating-point formats. Chosen real coefficient errors are not evidence that standard rounding, practical quantization or training creates these errors or risks.

The inherited architecture, Gaussian error and R011 statistical proof/review remain dependencies with their original bounds and N=2 qualifications. This audit rehashes actual dependencies, not every historical repository byte or every prior proof.
Historical pending-review wording is preserved. Separate LLM analytical reviews are not external human peer review, formal verification, numerical validation or novelty certification.

Prior-art URLs are inventoried without fresh fetching. Liu and Chen antecedents and different historical reading limits remain explicit. No third-party full text, new license or other repository content is added.
Only one nonmathematical process clause in CCR010 is neutralized. All mathematical, technical-condition, review, correction, scholarly-attribution and historical scientific bytes are unchanged.
No scientific or archived program was executed; no experiments, simulations, scientific enumeration, RNG, model initialization, source overwrites or remote writes occurred.
